title: 2001 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 9
statement: Two circles are concentric. The area of the ring between them is \(A\). In terms of \(A\), find the length of the longest chord contained entirely within the ring.

solutions.text: Let the radii of the circles be \(r\) and \(R>r\), so \(A=\pi\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)\). By the Pythagorean theorem, the length of the chord is \(2 \sqrt{R^{2}-r^{2}}=2 \sqrt{\frac{A}{\pi}}\).
